title: carex doniana var. minor
intro: Carex doniana var. minor, commonly known as Japanese sedge, is a type of plant species that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is a small, perennial herb with narrow leaves and a delicate appearance. The health benefits of Japanese sedge include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve immune function, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Japanese sedge include sesquiterpenes and other compounds that are responsible for its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
